build: local, offline (launch config near-world-offline-qa: relayer, NEAR AI and ElevenLabs keys blanked)
method: Browser pane, real keydown/keyup events through the game's input listener; the pane was hidden or occluded, so the game loop was stepped with __v2.sim instead of requestAnimationFrame. Camera yaw set directly to steer (as a mouse drag would). State edits are labelled below.

runs.A_fresh_player: Name, welcome, walk to Pema (66 m, about 22 s of game time at a run), her 4-line story, buy 3 from Tomas, the choice at Pema, haggle with Tomas (lowball 12 c -> 9 c), invest 15 shares, Rent Night, evening report, epilogue, week fast-forward. All with normal controls (F, number keys, Esc, T, J, C).
runs.B_profit_first: After the first day: Orchard pick (route 109 m, 54 game minutes), sold 6 to Arin at 6 c (+18 c per 3), goal rolled to 'Own shares in two stalls'.
runs.C_pema_support_closed: Friend's price (3 c) + invest, no further help: Pema's till 1 c at 09:20 -> 20 c at 21:00, rent 30 c, closed. Report 'Shutters down', epilogue names the player's part; reopened next morning; week: stayed open, +5 c dividends.
runs.C_pema_support_kept: Same save branched at step 7; followed the live advice at 17:20 ('buying 4 mangoes from her at 5 c puts 20 c in her till'): till 40 c at 21:00, rent paid, 10 c left.
runs.D_later_days: Week fast-forward then Day 9: five goals in the notebook (Orchard, Arin, shares in two stalls, 100 coins, all four open for a week), each with a live Next line.
runs.E_adverse: 3 c purse at Tomas: 'You need 5 c for one. You have 3 c.' (no buy button). 3 key presses + 2 clicks on one sale in one frame: exactly 1 receipt. Ask box with AI offline: scripted grounded answer in 0.5 s. Esc during Pema's epilogue: card stayed on 'Go and see her', replay completed it. Closed Pema at night with stocked shelves.
runs.F_returning_player: Reload mid-walk: position, day, coins restored. Reload at 21:03 after dismissing the report: no duplicate report (was: an empty second report).

balance_probe_14_days.how: Scratch script on the game's own offline economy (state.ts, sim.ts, haggle.ts, pricing.ts): orchard pick each morning, 6 visits a day, haggle lowball+flatter then deal.
balance_probe_14_days.reading: No dominant strategy: profit-first and invest-heavy end level; supporting Pema trades income for her survival. 100 c comes on day 2 for an efficient trader.

render_ms_gl_finish_median_of_3x60.note: Synchronous render cost per frame, not visible FPS (the window was not in view: requestAnimationFrame ran at 1.5 fps). RTX 3050, pixel ratio 1.
